bd2ea82588acb08b: does Corrext replace my translation agency?
b271b6d0402faf28: No. Corrext commands external review: in the project tunnel, a document may be sent to a legal translator or to a certified agency, in light review, full review or double review with certification. What the platform removes is not the agency, it is the obligation to place an order simply to read a part. Human work focuses where it relies, on the documents that are binding.
e0439bb50468bfce: Who links the documents to Corrext?
35ae5f9a3c59b2b1: Two ports, selected file by file. Internal review: your own lawyers or translators reappear on the platform, and the estimated time appears before you launch. External Review: the review is assigned to a legal translator or a certified agency, with an estimated time frame and an expiry date selected in a schedule. The same project can mix the two, row by row, in the file table.
45b789f5882a910e: What is the difference between the light review, full review and double review?
09cef6ae2ea803d2: Light Review: a translator corrects significant errors, omissions and contradictions; the result is complete and accurate, recommended to understand and transmit internally. Full Review: the translator also adapts consistency, idiomatism, style and tone; this is the ready-to-share version with third parties. Double review and certified translation: complete review by two qualified legal translators, with a certificate signed by the specialized agency certifying accuracy and impartiality, for judicial use, publication or authority.
4d257308a54e73fe: How can I get an estimate and a deadline?
417c7296622a32d4: They are calculated in the tool at the quotes stage of the Project Tunnel. Corrext counts the standard pages of each file, detects the language and legal category of the document, and then displays the preparation time, internal review time and external review time, as well as the total cost before taxes. You adjust the review level and the due date, and the estimate follows. No prior exchange is required to obtain this estimate.
d51031ef547c72d6: Can I keep the agency I already work with?
089e17225a98a474: External review ordered in Corrext is conducted through our network of certified legal translators and agencies. However, nothing prevents you from continuing to entrust your usual service provider with the documents that fall under his responsibility: your teams translate and replay the document in Corrext, and export it to its original format. If you want to integrate your own service provider into the project tunnel, this is something to consider together in a demo.

4ce0ace5f62e71c3: Frequently asked Questions about the Replay Editor
1dbb04b6101bf607: TAO stands for computer-aided translation (CAT tool). Such a tool cuts the document into segments, phrases or titles, and places each of them facing translation. The reviewer corrects and confirms each segment, with the help of memories and terminology. In Corrext, this tool is called the Replay Editor.
795700e83becad1d: How do I open the Replay Editor?
9f678afd55697d2e: From a project dashboard. Each file bears an open in CAT button, which opens the document in the editor. The project itself is created in project management: languages, confidentiality level, terminology and translation engine.
589c7fce6d83c903: Will my corrections be used for future translations?
8c368ffe351bba8b: Yes, in standard confidentiality. Your projects are stored on Swiss Corrext servers and used as translation memory on your own. A correction made today is included in your subsequent projects. The translation thus adapts to your language and remains consistent from one project to another.
29ee27abd2418b5a: And in highly sensitive content mode?
08415f92b85e0712: In this mode (high sensitive content), translations do not feed the memory. The data is stored and processed only in Switzerland. The fashion is available in French, German, Italian and English. You choose it when creating each project.
9639d09f38f64aa8: Can we read the same document together?
0d028bad4e426486: Yes. The Sync tab manages multiple work. It presents the conflicts between two versions of the same sentence, to be arbitrated. It lists the changes of a colleague to be included. Finally, he proposes to pass on a correction to the identical phrases of the document: it is propagation. The project team manages itself from the dashboard.
c53bf587d8ffd629: Do you need Microsoft Word to read?

d09a2e44a28eb034: In Standard confidentiality, the project is registered on Swiss Corrext servers and the data is processed in Switzerland or abroad according to the chosen translation engine; the project can then be used by you as a translation memory. c12b012e9fd2d784: What are the three levels of external review?
0cc038c8d3741480: Light Review, by a legal translator: material errors, omissions and contradictions of translation shall be corrected for a full and faithful translation intended for internal understanding and transmission. Full review by a legal translator: the translation is also suitable for consistency, idiomatic language, style and tone, ready to be shared with third parties. Double review and certified translation by a specialized agency: complete review by two qualified legal translators and signed certificate attesting to the accuracy and impartiality of the translation, for legal use, publication or delivery to the authorities.
95e37b9a418815da: You decide it file by file. In Internal Review, it is your own team: you provide its price per standard page and its approximate hourly price to value this work in the cost estimate. e1c2ffabd6be1af8: Because each change made after the translations are launched must be translated into all languages, read in each language and rechecked in layout. The cost of late correction is not proportional to the number of words changed, but to the number of languages multiplied by the number of steps already taken. A formal freeze, dated and communicated, is the most cost-effective measure of the project.

4dc3878dffed7fa9: Backwards from the date of publication. First place the publication and then go back: final validation, layout and replay of prints, language reinterpretation, translation, freezing of source text, fixed terminology, writing. Each previous milestone is constrained by the next, and freezing the source text is the point that affects all others.
a02ad3981fe23d7c: How can consistency be ensured between language versions of a report?
5eec538ad647154c: By deleting terminology before the first sentence translated, by designating one responsible person per language, and by treating recurring sections from year to year from previously published versions. 929250c1d3b28842: Who has to validate translated versions of an annual report?
674cbe6fdc1ae48c: A professional validator per language, capable of judging the substance, distinct from the language relector who judges the language. The validation must relate to an identified and dated version and be concluded by written agreement. Collective approval without a named responsible person produces contradictory remarks that no one has a mandate to decide.
